# IEC 62304 Development Review

Full GeLS development review for a **new module** destined for `certified/`.
Source of truth: *Software Development and Review Checklist* (Development tab).

**Module (index name):**
**Jira ticket (GDRP):**

> The merge gate blocks this PR until every checkbox below is ticked. For items
> that genuinely do not apply, tick the box and write `N/A — <reason>` next to it.

> **When to open this PR:** at the **end** of the development process, once RB1,
> RB2 and RB3 have all passed. The RB gates are tracked in Jira — they are *not*
> separate PRs. There is one PR per module, so a module never sits in
> `development/` on the default branch while it is still being worked on.

## Setup
- [ ] Module scaffolded on a `development/<INDEX_NAME>` branch — the New Module action created the files and registered the module in `AppModules.c/.h`.
- [ ] `APP_MODULES_CONFIG__ENABLE_<INDEX_NAME>` `#define` added in the app-side `Config.h`.
- [ ] `UnitTestManager.c/.h` updated: `#define` in `.h`, gated `#include` in `.c`, element added to `TestModulesArray_gro`.
- [ ] (PIOS only) New driver/port files added and `PIOS.h` updated — or `N/A` (not a PIOS driver).

## Documentation & requirements
- [ ] `.dox` header fields filled: file / author / version / date / brief.
- [ ] "Module Requirements and Tests" tab filled out.
- [ ] Function APIs defined in `module.h`, each with a Doxygen `@brief` / `@param` / `@return` that matches the requirements.
- [ ] Jira ticket created on the [GDRP board](https://genesysdesign.atlassian.net/jira/software/c/projects/GDRP/boards/16) and linked above.
- [ ] **RB1** — preliminary documentation review passed (Jira advanced to RB1).

## Implementation & test
- [ ] Functionality implemented in `module.c/.h` (step 6).
- [ ] Unit tests implemented in `moduleTest.c/.h`.
- [ ] All tests pass, with evidence captured in `Design/TestOutput/`.
- [ ] `@details` section of `module.dox` completed (Module Summary + How To Use).
- [ ] Review checklist tab completed.
- [ ] `Config.c` / `Config.h` updated.
- [ ] **RB2** — code review passed (Jira advanced to RB2).

## Integration
- [ ] Integrated and tested in a template project (list the project in comments) — or `N/A`.
- [ ] **RB3** — integration review passed (Jira advanced to RB3).

---
### On merge (reviewer / automation — not gated)
- With the `iec62304` label, automation moves the module from `development/` to `certified/`.
- Reviewer deletes the `development/*` branch and advances the Jira ticket to **IEC 62304 READY**.
- Commit to the protected branch must contain the version number.
